```sql
WITH ValidSpecimens AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM specimens
    WHERE run_started_at < '2024-06-01'
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT
        instrument_make,
        CASE WHEN well_count >= 303 THEN 'high' WHEN well_count >= 98 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS well_count_bucket,
        MIN(conc_ng_ml) AS min_conc_ng_ml,
        MIN(run_started_at) AS first_run_started_at
    FROM ValidSpecimens
    GROUP BY instrument_make, CASE WHEN well_count >= 303 THEN 'high' WHEN well_count >= 98 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT
    instrument_make,
    well_count_bucket,
    min_conc_ng_ml,
    first_run_started_at
FROM Agg
ORDER BY first_run_started_at, instrument_make, well_count_bucket
LIMIT 10;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_specimens = df_specimens.filter(F.col("run_started_at") < "2024-06-01")

agg = (
    valid_specimens
    .groupBy(
        "instrument_make",
        F.when(F.col("well_count") >= 303, "high").when(F.col("well_count") >= 98, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("well_count_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("conc_ng_ml").alias("min_conc_ng_ml"),
        F.min("run_started_at").alias("first_run_started_at"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .select(
        "instrument_make",
        "well_count_bucket",
        "min_conc_ng_ml",
        "first_run_started_at",
    )
    .orderBy("first_run_started_at", "instrument_make", "well_count_bucket")
    .limit(10)
)
```

```sql
SELECT deploy_result, COUNT(*) AS n_vm_instances, MIN(vcpu_cnt) AS min_vcpu_cnt, MIN(page_ack_min) AS min_page_ack_min FROM vm_instances vi WHERE vi.id NOT IN (SELECT cs.vm_instance_id FROM cpu_samples cs WHERE cs.mem_gib <= 555 AND (DATEDIFF(cs.provisioned_on, vi.provisioned_on) > 180 OR cs.page_sev <> 'sev3') AND cs.vcpu_cnt > 76) GROUP BY deploy_result ORDER BY min_page_ack_min DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_vm_instances.alias("vi")
    .join(
        df_cpu_samples.filter(F.col("vcpu_cnt") > 76).filter(F.col("mem_gib") <= 555).alias("cs"),
        (F.col("vi.id") == F.col("cs.vm_instance_id"))
        & ((F.datediff(F.col("cs.provisioned_on"), F.col("vi.provisioned_on")) > 180) | (F.col("cs.page_sev") != "sev3")),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .groupBy(F.col("vi.deploy_result"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_vm_instances"),
        F.min(F.col("vi.vcpu_cnt")).alias("min_vcpu_cnt"),
        F.min(F.col("vi.page_ack_min")).alias("min_page_ack_min"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_page_ack_min").desc())
)
```

```sql
WITH latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label, depot_zone ORDER BY dwell_secs NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM bus_routes
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(headway_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY depot_zone, stop_label ORDER BY CAST(tapped_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS headway_minutes_sum_90d,
        AVG(kiosk_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(tapped_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kiosk_revenue_avg_90d,
        AVG(kiosk_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label ORDER BY kiosk_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS kiosk_revenue_avg_3_prior,
        CORR(headway_minutes, dwell_secs) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', tapped_ts), depot_zone) AS corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs,
        ROUND(headway_minutes / SUM(headway_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label), 4) AS headway_minutes_share
    FROM latest
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching fare_tap per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.fare_tap_headway_minutes
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.headway_minutes AS fare_tap_headway_minutes
            FROM fare_taps c
            WHERE c.bus_route_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stop_seq DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT stop_label, id
    FROM latest_match
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT stop_label, id
    FROM bus_routes
    WHERE depot_zone = 'river'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.stop_label = k.stop_label AND s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        depot_zone,
        dwell_secs,
        headway_minutes,
        tapped_ts,
        headway_minutes_sum_90d,
        kiosk_revenue_avg_90d,
        corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs,
        ROUND(headway_minutes_sum_90d / SUM(headway_minutes_sum_90d) OVER (PARTITION BY depot_zone), 4) AS headway_minutes_sum_90d_share
    FROM kept_rows
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM fare_taps ch
            WHERE ch.bus_route_id = s.id
              AND ch.route_opened_date < s.tapped_ts
        )
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        depot_zone,
        dwell_secs,
        headway_minutes,
        headway_minutes_sum_90d,
        corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs,
        headway_minutes_sum_90d_share,
        headway_minutes - corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs AS headway_minutes_minus_corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs,
        CASE WHEN kiosk_revenue_avg_90d >= 2100 THEN 'High' WHEN kiosk_revenue_avg_90d >= 1073 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS kiosk_revenue_avg_90d_tier
    FROM kept
    WHERE tapped_ts > TIMESTAMP '2023-08-27 14:00:00'
)
SELECT
    depot_zone,
    dwell_secs,
    headway_minutes,
    headway_minutes_sum_90d,
    corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs,
    headway_minutes_minus_corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs,
    CASE WHEN depot_zone RLIKE '^(south|north)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN depot_zone RLIKE '^(river)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS depot_zone_zone
FROM filtered
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

latest = (
    df_bus_routes
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label", "depot_zone").orderBy(F.col("dwell_secs").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .withColumn("headway_minutes_sum_90d", F.sum("headway_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("depot_zone", "stop_label").orderBy(F.col("tapped_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("kiosk_revenue_avg_90d", F.avg("kiosk_revenue").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("tapped_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("kiosk_revenue_avg_3_prior", F.avg("kiosk_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label").orderBy("kiosk_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)))
    .withColumn("corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs", F.corr("headway_minutes", "dwell_secs").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "tapped_ts"), "depot_zone")))
    .withColumn("headway_minutes_share", F.round((F.col("headway_minutes") / F.sum("headway_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label"))), 4))
)

latest_match = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_fare_taps.alias("c"), (F.col("c.bus_route_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.stop_seq").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.headway_minutes").alias("fare_tap_headway_minutes"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    latest_match
    .select("stop_label", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_bus_routes
        .filter(F.col("depot_zone") == "river")
        .select("stop_label", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.stop_label") == F.col("k.stop_label")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "depot_zone",
        "dwell_secs",
        "headway_minutes",
        "tapped_ts",
        "headway_minutes_sum_90d",
        "kiosk_revenue_avg_90d",
        "corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs",
        F.round((F.col("headway_minutes_sum_90d") / F.sum("headway_minutes_sum_90d").over(Window.partitionBy("depot_zone"))), 4).alias("headway_minutes_sum_90d_share"),
    )
)

kept = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_fare_taps.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.bus_route_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.route_opened_date") < F.col("s.tapped_ts")), "left_anti")
)

filtered = (
    kept
    .filter(F.col("tapped_ts") > F.lit("2023-08-27 14:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "depot_zone",
        "dwell_secs",
        "headway_minutes",
        "headway_minutes_sum_90d",
        "corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs",
        "headway_minutes_sum_90d_share",
        (F.col("headway_minutes") - F.col("corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs")).alias("headway_minutes_minus_corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs"),
        F.when(F.col("kiosk_revenue_avg_90d") >= 2100, "High").when(F.col("kiosk_revenue_avg_90d") >= 1073, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("kiosk_revenue_avg_90d_tier"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "depot_zone",
        "dwell_secs",
        "headway_minutes",
        "headway_minutes_sum_90d",
        "corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs",
        "headway_minutes_minus_corr_headway_minutes_dwell_secs",
        F.when(F.col("depot_zone").rlike("^(south|north)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("depot_zone").rlike("^(river)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("depot_zone_zone"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(guide_rating, 1) AS guide_rating_rounded,
        CASE WHEN guide_rating >= 3.6 THEN 'High' WHEN guide_rating >= 2.0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS guide_rating_tier,
        COALESCE(guide_lang, 'NONE') AS guide_lang_filled
    FROM guide_staff
    WHERE posted_on >= DATE '2023-08-08'
      AND guide_lang IN ('th', 'ja')
),
valid_guide_staff AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN is_private THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_private_label
    FROM valid
    WHERE guide_lang IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach tour_operators attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.tour_operator_id,
        e.pkg_season,
        e.guide_lang,
        e.posted_on,
        e.guide_rating_rounded,
        e.guide_rating_tier,
        e.guide_lang_filled,
        t.pkg_price AS tour_operator_pkg_price,
        t.guide_rating AS tour_operator_guide_rating
    FROM valid_guide_staff e
    LEFT JOIN tour_operators t
        ON e.tour_operator_id = t.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        tour_operator_id,
        pkg_season,
        guide_rating_rounded,
        guide_rating_tier,
        guide_lang_filled,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tour_operator_pkg_price, id) AS row_seq,
        LAG(tour_operator_pkg_price, 1) OVER (ORDER BY tour_operator_pkg_price, id) AS prev_tour_operator_pkg_price,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY tour_operator_guide_rating, id) AS tour_operator_guide_rating_bucket,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(posted_on), tour_operator_id ORDER BY tour_operator_guide_rating DESC NULLS LAST) AS tour_operator_guide_rating_percent_rank,
        LEAD(guide_rating_rounded, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY tour_operator_id, guide_lang ORDER BY tour_operator_pkg_price, id) AS next_guide_rating_rounded
    FROM with_dims
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN row_seq >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS row_seq_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(pkg_season)) AS num_pkg_seasons
FROM metrics
GROUP BY CASE WHEN row_seq >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
ORDER BY row_seq_tier NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_guide_staff
    .filter((F.col("posted_on") >= F.lit("2023-08-08").cast("date")) & F.col("guide_lang").isin(["th", "ja"]))
    .withColumn("guide_rating_rounded", F.round("guide_rating", 1))
    .withColumn("guide_rating_tier", F.when(F.col("guide_rating") >= 3.6, "High").when(F.col("guide_rating") >= 2.0, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("guide_lang_filled", F.coalesce("guide_lang", F.lit("NONE")))
)

valid_guide_staff = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("guide_lang").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("is_private"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_private_label"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    valid_guide_staff
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_tour_operators.alias("t"), F.col("e.tour_operator_id") == F.col("t.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.tour_operator_id",
        "e.pkg_season",
        "e.guide_lang",
        "e.posted_on",
        "e.guide_rating_rounded",
        "e.guide_rating_tier",
        "e.guide_lang_filled",
        F.col("t.pkg_price").alias("tour_operator_pkg_price"),
        F.col("t.guide_rating").alias("tour_operator_guide_rating"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "tour_operator_id",
        "pkg_season",
        "guide_rating_rounded",
        "guide_rating_tier",
        "guide_lang_filled",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("tour_operator_pkg_price", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lag("tour_operator_pkg_price", 1).over(Window.orderBy("tour_operator_pkg_price", "id")).alias("prev_tour_operator_pkg_price"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy("tour_operator_guide_rating", "id")).alias("tour_operator_guide_rating_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("posted_on"), "tour_operator_id").orderBy(F.col("tour_operator_guide_rating").desc_nulls_last())).alias("tour_operator_guide_rating_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("guide_rating_rounded", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("tour_operator_id", "guide_lang").orderBy("tour_operator_pkg_price", "id")).alias("next_guide_rating_rounded"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("row_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("pkg_season")).alias("num_pkg_seasons"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("row_seq_tier").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
),
valid AS (

kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys

    FROM viewer_panels

),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.daypart = k.daypart
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT

    session_id,
    MAX(rating_pts_filled) FILTER (WHERE daypart = 'prime') AS prime_max_rating_pts_filled,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(rating_pts_filled, 0.5) AS rating_pts_filled_p50,
    MIN(rating_pts_filled) AS min_rating_pts_filled
FROM verified
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN rating_pts >= 16.2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, session_id), (CASE WHEN rating_pts >= 16.2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_gaps = (
    df_viewer_panels
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("spot_aired_ts") - F.lag("spot_aired_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "daypart",
        "rating_pts",
        "spot_aired_ts",
        "program_title",
        "flag_is_live",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    sessions
    .withColumn("running_session_id", F.sum("session_id").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("rating_pts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("rating_pts", "id")))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("rating_pts", "id")))
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") > 3)
    .select(
        "id",
        "daypart",
        "rating_pts",
        "program_title",
        "flag_is_live",
        "session_id",
        "seq_no",
        "seq_no_2",
        F.coalesce("rating_pts", F.lit(0)).alias("rating_pts_filled"),
    )
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") >= 7)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("daypart").isin(["late", "morning"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("daypart_group"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    valid
    .select("daypart")
    .intersect(
        df_viewer_panels
        .filter(F.col("program_title").like("%Bre%"))
        .select("daypart")
    )
)

verified = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.daypart") == F.col("k.daypart")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("rating_pts_tier", F.when(F.col("rating_pts") >= 16.2, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["rating_pts_tier", "session_id"], ["rating_pts_tier"]],
        "rating_pts_tier",
        "session_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.when(F.col("daypart") == "prime", F.col("rating_pts_filled"))).alias("prime_max_rating_pts_filled"),

)
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(kickoff_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY venue_surface ORDER BY kickoff_ts, id) IS NULL

islands AS (

    FROM gaps

    ROUND(AVG(minutes_played), 2) AS avg_minutes_played,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
```

```sql
    FROM filtered
    WHERE scrap_rate < 0.08
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(scrap_rate) OVER w_ordered AS scrap_rate_avg_5_prior,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY order_priority) AS order_priority_sum_seq_no,

    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY order_priority ORDER BY scrap_rate_bucket_2, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), w_hist AS (ORDER BY scrap_rate_bucket_2, id)
),
remaining_keys AS (

reconciled AS (

)
SELECT

    order_priority,
    scrap_rate,
    seq_no,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("order_priority").orderBy("scrap_rate_bucket_2", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w_hist = Window.orderBy("scrap_rate_bucket_2", "id")

filtered = (
    df_production_lines
    .filter((F.col("started_on") > F.lit("2023-07-20").cast("date")) & ~F.col("order_priority").isin(["P3", "P1"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "factory_id",
        "line_type",
        "order_priority",
        "scrap_rate",
        F.col("cycle_secs").cast("string").alias("cycle_secs_num"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("scrap_rate") < 0.08)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_priority",
        "scrap_rate",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_priority").orderBy(F.col("scrap_rate").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("scrap_rate", "id")).alias("scrap_rate_bucket"),
        F.stddev_samp("scrap_rate").over(Window.partitionBy("order_priority", "line_type")).alias("order_priority_stddev_samp_scrap_rate"),

    )
)

    enriched
    .withColumn("scrap_rate_avg_5_prior", F.avg("scrap_rate").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("order_priority_sum_seq_no", F.sum("seq_no").over(Window.partitionBy("order_priority")))
    .withColumn("prev_seq_no", F.lag("seq_no", 2).over(w_hist))
)

remaining_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("id", "order_priority")
    .exceptAll(
        df_production_lines
        .filter(F.col("factory_id").isin([5, 9, 15]))

    )

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.order_priority") == F.col("k.order_priority")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (

    .select(

        "order_priority",
        "scrap_rate",
        "seq_no",
        "scrap_rate_bucket",
        "order_priority_sum_seq_no",
```

```python
    df_warehouses_v
```
```python
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_pick_tasks.alias("c"), (F.col("c.warehouses_v_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.slot_start_ts") <= F.col("s.received_date")), "left_anti")
```

```python
    .withColumn("last4_min_lift_hrs", F.min("lift_hrs").over(w_ordered))
```

```sql
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE media_type = 'book') AS book_rows,
    STDDEV_SAMP(page_count) AS page_count_stddev,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN loan_days >= 39 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY STDDEV_SAMP(page_count) DESC) AS page_count_stddev_dense_rank
FROM ranked_holds_queue
GROUP BY CASE WHEN loan_days >= 39 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN page_count >= 854 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING STDDEV_SAMP(page_count) > 0
ORDER BY page_count_tier DESC NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

joined = (
    df_holds_queue
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_catalog_items.alias("b"), F.col("src.catalog_item_ref") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.catalog_item_ref",
        "src.page_count",
        "src.joined_on",
        F.col("b.due_on"),
        F.col("b.loan_days"),
        F.col("b.media_type"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy(F.col("joined_on").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "page_count", "joined_on", "due_on", "loan_days", "media_type")
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("prev_loan_days", F.lag("loan_days", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy("due_on", "id")))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy("joined_on", "id")))
    .withColumn("loan_days_avg_5", F.avg("loan_days").over(Window.orderBy("due_on", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)))
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy("joined_on")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

ranked = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy("due_on")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

ranked_holds_queue = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("rank_in_group_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy(F.col("loan_days_avg_5").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group_2") == 1)
    .select("id", "page_count", "loan_days", "media_type", "event_seq")
)

result = (
    ranked_holds_queue
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("loan_days") >= 39, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("loan_days_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("page_count") >= 854, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("page_count_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("media_type") == "book", F.col("loan_days")).otherwise(0)).alias("book_loan_days"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("media_type") == "book", 1)).alias("book_rows"),
        F.stddev_samp("page_count").alias("page_count_stddev"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("page_count_stddev") > 0)
    .withColumn("page_count_stddev_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("loan_days_tier").orderBy(F.col("page_count_stddev").desc())))
    .orderBy(F.col("page_count_tier").desc_nulls_last())
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned

),
```

```sql
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM fact_reviews x
            WHERE x.storefront_id = s.id
              AND x.account_opened_on < '2024-01-01'

),

    -- Latest matching fact_review per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.fact_review_basket_state
    FROM not_flagged s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.basket_state AS fact_review_basket_state
            FROM fact_reviews c
            WHERE c.storefront_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.basket_total DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cumulative_line_qty >= 41 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cumulative_line_qty_tier,
    basket_state,
    CASE WHEN line_qty_avg_2_prior >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS line_qty_avg_2_prior_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN fact_review_basket_state = 'open' THEN 1 END) AS open_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(store_tier)) AS store_tier_list,
    ROUND(SUM(store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fact_review_basket_state = 'checked_out' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty_per_checked_out,
    MAX(store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty) FILTER (WHERE store_tier = 'preferred') AS preferred_max_store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN cumulative_line_qty >= 41 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, basket_state, CASE WHEN line_qty_avg_2_prior >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END);
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("store_tier")

cleaned = (
    df_storefronts
    .filter(F.col("store_tier").isin(["mall", "standard"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "basket_state",
        "store_tier",
        "line_qty",
        "shopper_handle",
        F.trim("shopper_handle").alias("clean_shopper_handle"),
        F.concat_ws("-", "shopper_handle", "store_tier").alias("shopper_handle_store_tier_key"),
        F.coalesce("store_tier", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("store_tier_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "basket_state",
        "store_tier",
        "shopper_handle",
        "store_tier_filled",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("basket_state").orderBy("line_qty")).alias("line_qty_dense_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("line_qty").over(w_part).alias("store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty"),
        F.sum("line_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("basket_state").orderBy("line_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_line_qty"),
        F.avg("line_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("store_tier").orderBy("line_qty", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("line_qty_avg_2_prior"),
        F.last("store_tier", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("line_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_store_tier"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_fact_reviews.alias("x"), (F.col("x.storefront_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.account_opened_on") < "2024-01-01"), "left_anti")
)

with_latest = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_fact_reviews.alias("c"), (F.col("c.storefront_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.basket_total").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.basket_state").alias("fact_review_basket_state"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_line_qty") >= 41, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("cumulative_line_qty_tier"),
        "basket_state",
        F.when(F.col("line_qty_avg_2_prior") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("line_qty_avg_2_prior_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("fact_review_basket_state") == "open", 1)).alias("open_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("store_tier")).alias("store_tier_list"),
        F.round(F.sum("store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("fact_review_basket_state") == "checked_out", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty_per_checked_out"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("store_tier") == "preferred", F.col("store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty"))).alias("preferred_max_store_tier_stddev_samp_line_qty"),
    )
)
```

```python
        "island_id",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("property_type").orderBy("offer_made_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
```

```sql
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY crop_cycle_id, soil_class ORDER BY plot_hectares) AS plot_hectares_dense_rank
    FROM sessions
),
prev_events AS (
    SELECT *, LAG(valve_opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY season_tag ORDER BY valve_opened_at, id) AS prev_valve_opened_at

),

    FROM prev_events
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY season_tag ORDER BY valve_opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no_2
    FROM with_gaps_2
)

    c.crop_kind,
    s.soil_class,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    SUM(s.session_no) AS total_session_no
FROM sessionized s
LEFT JOIN crop_cycles c ON s.crop_cycle_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.harvest_grade, c.crop_kind, s.soil_class
ORDER BY soil_class DESC NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_harvest_logs
    .filter(F.col("soil_class").isNotNull() & (F.col("soil_class") != "loam"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("is_organic").cast("int").alias("is_organic_flag"),
        F.coalesce("soil_class", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("soil_class_clean"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("valve_opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("crop_cycle_id").orderBy("valve_opened_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("valve_opened_at") > F.lag("valve_opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("crop_cycle_id").orderBy("valve_opened_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("crop_cycle_id").orderBy("valve_opened_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

scored = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("germination_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("crop_cycle_id", "soil_class")).alias("crop_cycle_id_count_germination_pct"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("soil_class", "season_tag").orderBy("session_no", "id")).alias("session_no_bucket"),
        F.sum("germination_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("season_tag", "soil_class").orderBy("plot_hectares", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_germination_pct"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("crop_cycle_id", "soil_class").orderBy("plot_hectares")).alias("plot_hectares_dense_rank"),
    )
)

prev_events = scored.withColumn("prev_valve_opened_at", F.lag("valve_opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("season_tag").orderBy("valve_opened_at", "id")))

with_gaps_2 = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_valve_opened_at").isNull() | (F.col("valve_opened_at") > F.col("prev_valve_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps_2.withColumn("session_no_2", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("season_tag").orderBy("valve_opened_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_crop_cycles.alias("c"), F.col("s.crop_cycle_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")

        F.sum(F.col("s.session_no")).alias("total_session_no"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_fact_reviews
    .filter((F.col("account_opened_on") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-22"))) & F.col("basket_total").isNull())
    .withColumn("basket_total_band", F.when(F.col("basket_total") >= 1840, "High").when(F.col("basket_total") >= 930, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("basket_state_prefix", F.substring("basket_state", 1, 2))
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter((F.col("account_opened_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-07"))) & F.col("basket_state").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_tier",
        "basket_state",
        "basket_total",
        "basket_total_band",
        "basket_state_prefix",
        F.round("basket_total", 1).alias("basket_total_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("basket_state", F.lit("NONE")).alias("basket_state_filled"),
    )
)

filtered_fact_reviews = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("basket_state").isNotNull() & (~F.col("basket_state").eqNullSafe(F.lit("abandoned"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("basket_total", F.lit(0)).alias("basket_total_filled"),
        F.when(F.col("basket_state").isin(["open", "checked_out"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("basket_state_group"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered_fact_reviews
    .withColumn("first_known_basket_state", F.first("basket_state", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("basket_state", "store_tier").orderBy("basket_total_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("store_tier_avg_basket_total", F.avg("basket_total").over(Window.partitionBy("store_tier")))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_tier").orderBy(F.col("basket_total").desc(), "id")))
)

deduped = (

)

        F.round(F.avg("store_tier_avg_basket_total"), 2).alias("avg_store_tier_avg_basket_total"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.min("event_seq").alias("min_event_seq"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", 0.9).alias("event_seq_p90"),
        F.percentile_approx("store_tier_avg_basket_total", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("store_tier_avg_basket_total_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_rows") >= 1)
)

result = (

    .select(

        "num_rows",
        "distinct_ids",
        "min_event_seq",
```

```sql
        latest.exhibition_wing_name
    FROM base s

            SELECT c.closes_on, c.wing_name AS exhibition_wing_name
            FROM exhibitions c

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(scanned_at) OVER (PARTITION BY exhibition_wing_name ORDER BY scanned_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR scanned_at > LAG(scanned_at) OVER (PARTITION BY exhibition_wing_name ORDER BY scanned_at, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM ranked
),
islands AS (

    SELECT

        closes_on,
        exhibition_wing_name,
        rank_in_group,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY exhibition_wing_name ORDER BY scanned_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
)

    island_id,
    SUM(island_id) FILTER (WHERE exhibition_wing_name = 'annex') AS annex_total_island_id,
    ROUND(SUM(island_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN exhibition_wing_name = 'east' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS island_id_per_east,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(exhibition_wing_name)) AS num_exhibition_wing_names,
    COUNT_IF(exhibition_wing_name = 'west') AS west_events,

    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(exhibition_wing_name)) AS exhibition_wing_name_list,
    GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', scanned_at)) AS grouping_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_galleries
    .filter((F.col("scanned_at") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-05-10 13:00:00"))) & F.col("wing_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "loan_state",
        "wing_name",
        "ticket_price",
        "scanned_at",
        F.round("ticket_price", 2).alias("ticket_price_rounded"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_exhibitions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.gallery_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.closes_on") <= F.col("s.scanned_at")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.closes_on").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.closes_on"),
        F.col("c.wing_name").alias("exhibition_wing_name"),
    )
)

base_galleries = (
    with_latest
    .filter(F.col("scanned_at") >= F.lit("2023-10-13").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.initcap(F.trim("loan_state")).alias("loan_state_title"))
)

ranked = (
    base_galleries
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("loan_state").orderBy(F.col("scanned_at").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

flagged = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("scanned_at").over(Window.partitionBy("exhibition_wing_name").orderBy("scanned_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("scanned_at") > F.lag("scanned_at").over(Window.partitionBy("exhibition_wing_name").orderBy("scanned_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "scanned_at",
        "ticket_price_rounded",
        "closes_on",
        "exhibition_wing_name",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("exhibition_wing_name").orderBy("scanned_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "scanned_at"))

        "island_id",

        F.size(F.collect_set("exhibition_wing_name")).alias("num_exhibition_wing_names"),
        F.count_if(F.col("exhibition_wing_name") == "west").alias("west_events"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("scanned_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("scanned_at"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("exhibition_wing_name")).alias("exhibition_wing_name_list"),
        F.grouping("quarter_start").alias("grouping_id"),
```

```sql
),
```

```sql
        LEAD(ticket_price, 1) OVER (ORDER BY insured_value_rank, id) AS next_ticket_price
    FROM metrics
),

    INTERSECT

reconciled AS (

),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,

        MIN(next_ticket_price) OVER w_grp AS ticket_class_min_next_ticket_price,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY first_known_ticket_price DESC NULLS FIRST) AS first_known_ticket_price_rank,
```

```python
        "id",
        "loan_state",
        "ticket_class",
        "ticket_price",
        "artist_credit",
        "is_on_display",
        F.last("ticket_price", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("loan_state").orderBy("insured_value", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_ticket_price"),
        F.lag("insured_value", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_class", "loan_state").orderBy("opens_on", "id")).alias("prev_insured_value"),
```

```sql
),
verified as (

    select s.*
    from valid s
    join remaining_keys k on s.campus_id = k.campus_id and s.house_name = k.house_name
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        avg(lesson_minutes) over (partition by date_trunc('WEEK', enrolled_on), house_name) as enrolled_on_period_avg_lesson_minutes,
        stddev_samp(lesson_minutes) over (partition by campus_id) as campus_id_stddev_samp_lesson_minutes,
        percent_rank() over w_ordered as lesson_minutes_whole_percent_rank,
        round(lesson_minutes / sum(lesson_minutes) over (partition by subject_area), 4) as lesson_minutes_share,
        max(lesson_minutes_whole) over (partition by house_name) as house_name_max_lesson_minutes_whole
    from verified
    window w_ordered as (partition by date_trunc('WEEK', enrolled_on), house_name order by lesson_minutes_whole desc nulls first)
)
select
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
cleaned = (
    df_production_lines

with_latest = (

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.started_on",
        "s.is_rework",
        "s.is_rework_flag",
        "s.order_priority_filled",
        F.col("c.order_priority").alias("machine_asset_order_priority"),
    )
)

with_latest_production_lines = (
```

```python
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("fuel_type", "power_plant_id").orderBy("voltage_kv", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (

        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "inspected_date").alias("days_since_inspected_date"),
        F.when(F.col("fuel_type") == "coal", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_coal"),
    )
)

enriched = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "power_plant_id",
        "zone_code",
        "voltage_kv",
        "is_renewable",
        "days_since_inspected_date",
        "is_coal",
        F.last("days_since_inspected_date", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered).alias("last_known_days_since_inspected_date"),
        F.sum("voltage_kv").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "inspected_date")).orderBy("inspected_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_voltage_kv"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("running_voltage_kv") <= 704)
    .select(

        "power_plant_id",
        "zone_code",
        "voltage_kv",
        "days_since_inspected_date",
        "is_coal",
        "running_voltage_kv",
        F.lead("last_known_days_since_inspected_date").over(Window.partitionBy("power_plant_id", "zone_code").orderBy("days_since_inspected_date", "id")).alias("next_last_known_days_since_inspected_date"),

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("power_plant_id", "zone_code").orderBy("days_since_inspected_date", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.round((F.col("voltage_kv") / F.sum("voltage_kv").over(Window.partitionBy("power_plant_id"))), 4).alias("voltage_kv_share"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("voltage_kv").over(Window.partitionBy("power_plant_id").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_voltage_kv_2"),
        F.sum("voltage_kv").over(Window.orderBy("next_last_known_days_since_inspected_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_voltage_kv_3"),

        [["event_seq_tier", "zone_code"], ["event_seq_tier"]],
        "event_seq_tier",
        "zone_code",

        F.round(F.sum("running_voltage_kv_2") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("zone_code") == "Z3", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_voltage_kv_2_per_z3"),
```

```sql
        rn,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY maintenance_job_id ORDER BY prev_egt_margin_c, id) AS prev_egt_margin_c_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_egt_margin_c) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY maintenance_job_id ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_egt_margin_c
    FROM deduped
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', delivered_on) AS activity_month,
    tech_license,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_egt_margin_c_bucket, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS prev_egt_margin_c_bucket_quartiles,
    SUM(prev_egt_margin_c_bucket) FILTER (WHERE tech_license = 'C') AS c_total_prev_egt_margin_c_bucket,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_known_running_egt_margin_c, 0.5) AS first_known_running_egt_margin_c_p50,
    MAX(first_known_running_egt_margin_c) FILTER (WHERE tech_license = 'B2') AS b2_max_first_known_running_egt_margin_c,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(tech_license)) AS num_tech_licenses,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM scored
GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', delivered_on), tech_license)
HAVING SUM(prev_egt_margin_c_bucket) FILTER (WHERE tech_license = 'C') < 1000000
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_part_swaps
    .filter(F.col("tech_license").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("tail_number_filled", F.coalesce("tail_number", F.lit("unassigned")))
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("maintenance_job_id").orderBy(F.col("egt_margin_c").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("maintenance_job_id").isin([1, 15, 29, 33]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("maintenance_job_id").orderBy(F.col("dedup_rank").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lag("egt_margin_c", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("airframe").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")).alias("prev_egt_margin_c"),
        F.sum("egt_margin_c").over(Window.partitionBy("airframe").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_egt_margin_c"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("tech_license", "maintenance_job_id").orderBy("cycle_count", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("egt_margin_c").over(Window.partitionBy("tech_license").orderBy("cycle_count", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_egt_margin_c"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_maintenance_jobs.alias("m"), F.col("s.maintenance_job_id") == F.col("m.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.maintenance_job_id",
        "s.tech_license",
        "s.cycle_count",
        "s.egt_margin_c",
        "s.tail_number_filled",
        "s.dedup_rank",
        "s.prev_egt_margin_c",
        "s.running_egt_margin_c",
        F.col("m.egt_margin_c").alias("maintenance_job_egt_margin_c"),
        F.col("m.delivered_on"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("tech_license").orderBy("dedup_rank")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "tech_license",
        "tail_number_filled",
        "dedup_rank",
        "delivered_on",
        "rn",
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("maintenance_job_id").orderBy("prev_egt_margin_c", "id")).alias("prev_egt_margin_c_bucket"),
        F.first("running_egt_margin_c", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("maintenance_job_id").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_running_egt_margin_c"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "delivered_on"))
    .rollup("activity_month", "tech_license")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("prev_egt_margin_c_bucket", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("prev_egt_margin_c_bucket_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("tech_license") == "C", F.col("prev_egt_margin_c_bucket"))).alias("c_total_prev_egt_margin_c_bucket"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("first_known_running_egt_margin_c", 0.5).alias("first_known_running_egt_margin_c_p50"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("tech_license") == "B2", F.col("first_known_running_egt_margin_c"))).alias("b2_max_first_known_running_egt_margin_c"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("tech_license")).alias("num_tech_licenses"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("c_total_prev_egt_margin_c_bucket") < 1000000)
)
```

```sql
metrics AS (

        LEAD(floor_sqm, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY property_type ORDER BY offer_made_ts_date, id) AS next_floor_sqm
    FROM not_flagged
),
not_flagged_listings AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (

            WHERE ch.listing_id = s.id
              AND ch.offer_made_at < s.offer_made_ts_date

kept AS (

)
```

```sql
    from valid_gyms

not_flagged as (

    greatest_kcal_burned_minus_session_mins_session_mins,
```

```python
    base
    .select("id", "league_div")
    .intersect(

        .filter(F.length("club_motto") < 14)

    base
    .alias("s")

    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_fixtures.alias("b"), F.col("src.fixture_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.fixture_id",
        "src.league_div",
        "src.sprint_kmh",
        "src.mins_played",

    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("position_code").isNotNull() & F.col("mins_played").between(44, 66))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("sprint_kmh") - F.col("mins_played")).alias("sprint_kmh_minus_mins_played"),
        F.concat("league_div", F.lit("/"), "position_code").alias("league_div_position_code"),

)

    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("league_div") == "D3")
    .withColumn("position_code_filled", F.coalesce("position_code", F.lit("N/A")))

    cleaned_goal_events
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("sprint_kmh") >= 32.0, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("sprint_kmh_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "fixture_day_month_end").alias("year_start"),
```

```python
        "dwell_seconds",

        F.greatest("dwell_seconds", "kiosk_revenue").alias("greatest_dwell_seconds_kiosk_revenue"),
        F.add_months("route_opened_date", 6).alias("route_opened_date_plus_months"),
```

```python
        "store_tier",
        "pay_mode",
        "basket_total",

        "line_net",

        "basket_total",

    )
)
```

```python
        F.max("storey_no").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("offer_made_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)).alias("storey_no_max_30d"),
    )
)

    .filter(F.col("listing_status") == "ACTIVE")
    .select(
        "*",
```

```sql
        *,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

metrics = (
    df_housekeeping_tasks
    .select(
        "id",
        "stay_channel",
        "occupancy_percent",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("hotel_id").orderBy(F.col("checkout_day").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lag("occupancy_percent", 1).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "checkout_day"), "stay_channel").orderBy("occupancy_percent", "id")).alias("prev_occupancy_percent"),
        F.sum("occupancy_percent").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "checkout_day"), "stay_channel").orderBy("checkout_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_occupancy_percent"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("cumulative_occupancy_percent") <= 224)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("stay_channel").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_max_event_seq"),
        F.sum("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("stay_channel").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_sum_event_seq"),
        F.avg("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("stay_channel").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_avg_event_seq"),
    )
)

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("stay_channel").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))

    .withColumn("cumulative_last4_max_event_seq", F.sum("last4_max_event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("stay_channel").orderBy("last4_max_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_dock_slots
    .filter((F.col("received_on") > F.lit("2023-07-25").cast("date")) & F.col("pick_wave").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "lift_model",
        "pick_wave",
        "slot_minutes",
        "received_on",
        F.when(F.col("lift_model").isin(["Jungheinrich", "Linde"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("lift_model_group"),
        F.coalesce("pick_wave", F.lit("N/A")).alias("pick_wave_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.year("received_on") == 2023)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("received_on"), "lift_model").orderBy(F.col("slot_minutes").desc())).alias("slot_minutes_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("pick_wave").orderBy(F.col("slot_minutes").desc())).alias("slot_minutes_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("slot_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "received_on"), "pick_wave").orderBy("received_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_slot_minutes"),
        F.min("slot_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("received_on"), "pick_wave")).alias("received_on_year_min_slot_minutes"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("pick_wave", "lift_model").orderBy(F.col("received_on_year_min_slot_minutes").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")

latest_dock_slots = (

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("pick_wave").orderBy(F.col("slot_minutes").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest_dock_slots
    .withColumn("slot_minutes_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "received_on")).orderBy("slot_minutes")))
    .withColumn("next_received_on_year_min_slot_minutes", F.lead("received_on_year_min_slot_minutes", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("lift_model").orderBy("slot_minutes_cume_dist", "id")))
    .withColumn("received_on_year_min_slot_minutes_avg_6_prior", F.avg("received_on_year_min_slot_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("pick_wave").orderBy("slot_minutes_percent_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)))

    .agg(
```

```sql
deduped AS (

        FROM kept
    ) t

report AS (
```

```sql
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY teu_capacity_share_tier, quarter_start
```

```python
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.crew_role") == F.col("k.crew_role")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .select(

        "voyage_state",
        "freight_usd",
        "departed_on",
        F.max("teu_capacity").over(w_hist).alias("departed_on_month_max_teu_capacity"),
        F.round((F.col("teu_capacity") / F.sum("teu_capacity").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("departed_on"), "crew_role"))), 4).alias("teu_capacity_share"),
```

```sql
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN stop_label IN ('Depot', 'Pier') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS stop_label_group,
        CAST(is_accessible AS INT) AS is_accessible_flag
    FROM depots
    WHERE stop_label = 'Pier'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        tap_media,
        stop_label,
        visited_at,
        kiosk_owner,
        is_accessible,
        stop_label_group,
        CAST(is_accessible AS INT) AS is_accessible_flag_2,
        DAYOFWEEK(visited_at) AS visited_at_dayofweek
    FROM base
    WHERE is_accessible = TRUE
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        tap_media,
        visited_at,
        is_accessible,
        stop_label_group,
        visited_at_dayofweek,
        MIN(visited_at_dayofweek) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label, tap_media ORDER BY visited_at_dayofweek, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek,
        MAX(visited_at_dayofweek) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label, tap_media ORDER BY visited_at_dayofweek, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek,
        COUNT(visited_at_dayofweek) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label, tap_media ORDER BY visited_at_dayofweek, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_count_visited_at_dayofweek,
        SUM(visited_at_dayofweek) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label, tap_media ORDER BY visited_at_dayofweek, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_sum_visited_at_dayofweek
    FROM filtered
),
base_depots AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        tap_media,
        visited_at,
        is_accessible,
        visited_at_dayofweek,
        last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek,
        last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek,
        last7_count_visited_at_dayofweek,
        last7_sum_visited_at_dayofweek,
        CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_accessible_label
    FROM metrics
    WHERE visited_at >= DATE '2023-04-02'
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', visited_at) AS quarter_start,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(tap_media)) AS num_tap_medias,
        ROUND(SUM(last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN tap_media = 'card' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek_per_card,
        MAX(visited_at_dayofweek) FILTER (WHERE tap_media = 'qr') AS qr_max_visited_at_dayofweek,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek, 0.9) AS last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek_p90,
        MAX(visited_at) AS last_seen,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(tap_media)) AS tap_media_list
    FROM base_depots
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', visited_at)
)
SELECT
    quarter_start,
    num_tap_medias,
    last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek_per_card,
    qr_max_visited_at_dayofweek,
    last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek_p90,
    last_seen
FROM summary
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_depots
    .filter(F.col("stop_label") == "Pier")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("stop_label").isin(["Depot", "Pier"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other").alias("stop_label_group"),
        F.col("is_accessible").cast("int").alias("is_accessible_flag"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("is_accessible"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "tap_media",
        "stop_label",
        "visited_at",
        "kiosk_owner",
        "is_accessible",
        "stop_label_group",
        F.col("is_accessible").cast("int").alias("is_accessible_flag_2"),
        F.dayofweek("visited_at").alias("visited_at_dayofweek"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "tap_media",
        "visited_at",
        "is_accessible",
        "stop_label_group",
        "visited_at_dayofweek",
        F.min("visited_at_dayofweek").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label", "tap_media").orderBy("visited_at_dayofweek", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek"),
        F.max("visited_at_dayofweek").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label", "tap_media").orderBy("visited_at_dayofweek", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek"),
        F.count("visited_at_dayofweek").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label", "tap_media").orderBy("visited_at_dayofweek", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_count_visited_at_dayofweek"),
        F.sum("visited_at_dayofweek").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label", "tap_media").orderBy("visited_at_dayofweek", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_sum_visited_at_dayofweek"),
    )
)

base_depots = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("visited_at") >= F.lit("2023-04-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "tap_media",
        "visited_at",
        "is_accessible",
        "visited_at_dayofweek",
        "last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek",
        "last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek",
        "last7_count_visited_at_dayofweek",
        "last7_sum_visited_at_dayofweek",
        F.when(F.col("is_accessible"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_accessible_label"),
    )
)

summary = (
    base_depots
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "visited_at").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("tap_media")).alias("num_tap_medias"),
        F.round(F.sum("last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("tap_media") == "card", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek_per_card"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("tap_media") == "qr", F.col("visited_at_dayofweek"))).alias("qr_max_visited_at_dayofweek"),
        F.percentile_approx("last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek", 0.9).alias("last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek_p90"),
        F.max("visited_at").alias("last_seen"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("tap_media")).alias("tap_media_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "quarter_start",
        "num_tap_medias",
        "last7_max_visited_at_dayofweek_per_card",
        "qr_max_visited_at_dayofweek",
        "last7_min_visited_at_dayofweek_p90",
        "last_seen",
    )
)
```

```sql
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(panel_size) OVER (PARTITION BY broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS panel_size_avg_5,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size) AS panel_size_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY broadcast_id, panel_region ORDER BY panel_size) AS panel_size_rank
    FROM ad_spots
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY spot_kind ORDER BY panel_size_avg_5 NULLS FIRST) AS rn
        FROM with_windows
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
deduped_ad_spots AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM deduped
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
with_windows_ad_spots AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        panel_region,
        spot_kind,
        is_rerun,
        panel_size_avg_5,
        LEAD(panel_size_avg_5) OVER (PARTITION BY spot_kind, broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size_dense_rank, id) AS next_panel_size_avg_5,
        LAG(panel_size_avg_5) OVER (PARTITION BY spot_kind, broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size_dense_rank, id) AS prev_panel_size_avg_5,
        LEAD(panel_size_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY spot_kind, broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size_dense_rank, id) AS next_panel_size_dense_rank,
        LAG(panel_size_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY spot_kind, broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size_dense_rank, id) AS prev_panel_size_dense_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY spot_kind, broadcast_id ORDER BY panel_size_dense_rank, id) AS seq_no
    FROM deduped_ad_spots
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    seq_no,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN panel_region = 'UPC' THEN 1 END) AS upc_count,
    COUNT_IF(panel_region = 'BKK') AS bkk_events,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(panel_region)) AS panel_region_list,
```

```sql
      and panel_region in ('UPC', 'BKK', 'SOUTH')
),
joined as (
    -- Attach broadcasts attributes
    select
        e.id,
        e.broadcast_id,
        e.spot_kind,
        e.is_rerun,
        e.panel_size_rounded,
        b.share_percent
    from filtered e
    left join broadcasts b
        on e.broadcast_id <=> b.id
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        broadcast_id,
        spot_kind,
        is_rerun,
        panel_size_rounded,
        share_percent,
        row_number() over (partition by broadcast_id order by panel_size_rounded desc, id asc) as seq_no,
        lead(share_percent, 1) over (partition by spot_kind order by share_percent asc, id asc) as next_share_percent,
        first_value(spot_kind) ignore nulls over (partition by broadcast_id order by panel_size_rounded asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_spot_kind
    from joined
    where is_rerun = true
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by spot_kind, broadcast_id order by seq_no desc, id asc) as row_seq,
        lag(panel_size_rounded, 1) over (partition by spot_kind order by panel_size_rounded asc, id asc) as prev_panel_size_rounded,
        lag(seq_no, 2) over (order by share_percent asc, id asc) as prev_seq_no
    from enriched
),
joined_ad_spots as (
    -- Attach broadcasts attributes
    select
        a.*,
        d.daypart,
        d.share_percent as broadcast_share_percent,
        d.spot_type
    from scored a
    left join broadcasts d
        on a.broadcast_id = d.id
),
scored_ad_spots as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        broadcast_id,
        spot_kind,
        is_rerun,
        panel_size_rounded,
        seq_no,
        next_share_percent,
        row_seq,
        prev_panel_size_rounded,
        daypart,
        broadcast_share_percent,
        avg(row_seq) over (partition by daypart order by broadcast_share_percent asc, id asc rows between 6 preceding and current row) as row_seq_avg_6,
        avg(next_share_percent) over (partition by spot_kind order by next_share_percent asc, id asc rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as next_share_percent_avg_3_prior,
        cume_dist() over (order by prev_panel_size_rounded asc nulls last) as prev_panel_size_rounded_cume_dist,
        percent_rank() over (partition by spot_kind order by prev_seq_no asc nulls first) as prev_seq_no_percent_rank
    from joined_ad_spots
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id
    from scored_ad_spots
    intersect all
    select id
    from ad_spots
    where program_title not like 'M%'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored_ad_spots s
    join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    daypart,
    sum(case when spot_kind = 'ad' then row_seq_avg_6 else 0 end) as ad_row_seq_avg_6,
    round(avg(next_share_percent), 2) as avg_next_share_percent,
    count(distinct daypart) as distinct_dayparts
from kept_rows
group by daypart
having avg_next_share_percent > 0
order by ad_row_seq_avg_6 asc nulls last
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_ad_spots
    .filter((F.col("aired_on") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-20"))) & F.col("panel_region").isin(["UPC", "BKK", "SOUTH"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "broadcast_id",
        "panel_region",
        "spot_kind",
        "share_pct",
        "panel_size",
        "aired_on",
        "program_title",
        "is_rerun",
        F.round("panel_size", 2).alias("panel_size_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("spot_kind", F.lit("N/A")).alias("spot_kind_filled"),
    )
)

joined = (
    filtered
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_broadcasts.alias("b"), F.col("e.broadcast_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.broadcast_id",
        "e.spot_kind",
        "e.is_rerun",
        "e.panel_size_rounded",
        F.col("b.share_percent"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("is_rerun"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "broadcast_id",
        "spot_kind",
        "is_rerun",
        "panel_size_rounded",
        "share_percent",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("broadcast_id").orderBy(F.col("panel_size_rounded").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.lead("share_percent", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("spot_kind").orderBy("share_percent", "id")).alias("next_share_percent"),
        F.first("spot_kind", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("broadcast_id").orderBy("panel_size_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_spot_kind"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("spot_kind", "broadcast_id").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("prev_panel_size_rounded", F.lag("panel_size_rounded", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("spot_kind").orderBy("panel_size_rounded", "id")))
    .withColumn("prev_seq_no", F.lag("seq_no", 2).over(Window.orderBy("share_percent", "id")))
)

joined_ad_spots = (
    scored
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_broadcasts.alias("d"), F.col("a.broadcast_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("d.daypart"),
        F.col("d.share_percent").alias("broadcast_share_percent"),
        F.col("d.spot_type"),
    )
)

scored_ad_spots = (
    joined_ad_spots
    .select(
        "id",
        "broadcast_id",
        "spot_kind",
        "is_rerun",
        "panel_size_rounded",
        "seq_no",
        "next_share_percent",
        "row_seq",
        "prev_panel_size_rounded",
        "daypart",
        "broadcast_share_percent",
        F.avg("row_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("broadcast_share_percent", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("row_seq_avg_6"),
        F.avg("next_share_percent").over(Window.partitionBy("spot_kind").orderBy("next_share_percent", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("next_share_percent_avg_3_prior"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_panel_size_rounded").asc_nulls_last())).alias("prev_panel_size_rounded_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("spot_kind").orderBy(F.col("prev_seq_no").asc_nulls_first())).alias("prev_seq_no_percent_rank"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored_ad_spots
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_ad_spots
        .filter(~F.col("program_title").like("M%"))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored_ad_spots
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy("daypart")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("spot_kind") == "ad", F.col("row_seq_avg_6")).otherwise(0)).alias("ad_row_seq_avg_6"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_share_percent"), 2).alias("avg_next_share_percent"),
        F.countDistinct("daypart").alias("distinct_dayparts"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_next_share_percent") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("ad_row_seq_avg_6").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
    SELECT
```
```sql
        *,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("course_type").orderBy("opened_day", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.partitionBy("course_type").orderBy("prep_minutes", "id")

filtered = (
    df_menu_dishes
    .filter(F.col("cuisine_type").isin(["indian", "mexican", "japanese"]))
    .withColumn("line_qty_rounded", F.round("line_qty", 0))
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_eateries.alias("p2"), F.col("e.eatery_no").eqNullSafe(F.col("p2.id")), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("p2.seat_zone"),
        F.col("p2.dish_title"),
        F.col("p2.prep_minutes"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "eatery_no",
        "cuisine_type",
        "spice_lvl",
        "opened_day",
        "line_qty_rounded",
        "seat_zone",
        "dish_title",
        "prep_minutes",
        F.count("prep_minutes").over(w_hist).alias("last3_count_prep_minutes"),
        F.avg("prep_minutes").over(w_hist).alias("last3_avg_prep_minutes"),
        F.min("prep_minutes").over(w_hist).alias("last3_min_prep_minutes"),
        F.sum("prep_minutes").over(w_hist).alias("last3_sum_prep_minutes"),
        F.lag("line_qty", 2).over(w_part).alias("prev_line_qty"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("running_max_spice_lvl", F.max("spice_lvl").over(Window.partitionBy("cuisine_type").orderBy("last3_count_prep_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_sum_spice_lvl", F.sum("spice_lvl").over(Window.partitionBy("cuisine_type").orderBy("last3_count_prep_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_count_spice_lvl", F.count("spice_lvl").over(Window.partitionBy("cuisine_type").orderBy("last3_count_prep_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_min_spice_lvl", F.min("spice_lvl").over(Window.partitionBy("cuisine_type").orderBy("last3_count_prep_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("spice_lvl").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("first_known_last3_avg_prep_minutes", F.first("last3_avg_prep_minutes", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("cuisine_type").orderBy("running_max_spice_lvl", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_max_spice_lvl_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("seat_zone").orderBy(F.col("running_max_spice_lvl").asc_nulls_last())))
    .withColumn("last_known_last3_avg_prep_minutes", F.last("last3_avg_prep_minutes", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("opened_day"), "eatery_no").orderBy("spice_lvl", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy("cuisine_type", "eatery_no")
    .pivot("seat_zone", ["hall", "bar"])
    .agg(F.sum("prev_line_qty"))
)
```

```python
        F.coalesce("stop_label", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("stop_label_filled"),

)

        F.lead("event_seq", 1).over(w_running).alias("next_event_seq"),
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("soil_class").isNotNull() & (~F.col("soil_class").eqNullSafe(F.lit("clay"))))
```

```sql
        parcel_kg,
        account_opened_date,

        SUM(review_stars) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_mode ORDER BY account_opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_review_stars,
        LAST_VALUE(parcel_kg) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY basket_status, pay_mode ORDER BY review_stars, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_parcel_kg,
        LEAD(review_stars, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY basket_status ORDER BY parcel_kg, id) AS next_review_stars
    FROM shopper_accounts
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM baskets x
            WHERE x.shopper_account_id = s.id
              AND x.account_opened_on <= s.account_opened_date
        )
),
not_flagged_shopper_accounts AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM baskets ch
            WHERE ch.shopper_account_id = s.id
              AND ch.basket_total BETWEEN 1100 AND 1900
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(running_review_stars) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_mode ORDER BY running_review_stars, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_running_review_stars,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_mode ORDER BY next_review_stars DESC, id) AS next_review_stars_bucket,
        LAG(running_review_stars, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY basket_status, pay_mode ORDER BY parcel_kg, id) AS prev_running_review_stars,
        MAX(running_review_stars) OVER (PARTITION BY basket_status, pay_mode) AS basket_status_max_running_review_stars
    FROM not_flagged_shopper_accounts
    WHERE running_review_stars BETWEEN 12 AND 14
)
SELECT
    id,
    pay_mode,
    basket_status,
    parcel_kg,
    is_flash_sale,
    running_running_review_stars,
    prev_running_review_stars,
    CASE WHEN pay_mode RLIKE '^(card|bnpl)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN pay_mode RLIKE '^(cod|wallet)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS pay_mode_zone
FROM enriched
```

```python
    df_shopper_accounts
    .select(

        "parcel_kg",
        "account_opened_date",
        "is_flash_sale",
        F.sum("review_stars").over(Window.partitionBy("pay_mode").orderBy("account_opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_review_stars"),
        F.last("parcel_kg", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("basket_status", "pay_mode").orderBy("review_stars", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_parcel_kg"),
        F.lead("review_stars", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("basket_status").orderBy("parcel_kg", "id")).alias("next_review_stars"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_baskets.alias("x"), (F.col("x.shopper_account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.account_opened_on") <= F.col("s.account_opened_date")), "left_anti")

    .withColumn("prev_running_review_stars", F.lag("running_review_stars", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("basket_status", "pay_mode").orderBy("parcel_kg", "id")))
    .withColumn("basket_status_max_running_review_stars", F.max("running_review_stars").over(Window.partitionBy("basket_status", "pay_mode")))
)

result = (

        "pay_mode",
        "basket_status",

        "is_flash_sale",
```

```python
    df_realtors
    .filter(F.col("district_code") == "D01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "district_code",
        "floor_sqm",
        "listed_on",
        F.col("storey_no").cast("string").alias("storey_no_num"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base
    .select("district_code", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_realtors
        .filter(F.col("floor_sqm") <= 220)
        .select("district_code", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.district_code") == F.col("k.district_code")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

    verified
    .filter(F.col("listed_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-01")))
```

```sql
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', commissioned_on) commissioned_on_period
    FROM power_plants
    WHERE MONTH(commissioned_on) IN (5, 7, 11)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_type ORDER BY commissioned_on, id) AS row_num
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(commissioned_on_period) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_type ORDER BY commissioned_on_period, id) IS NULL
                 OR commissioned_on_period > LAG(commissioned_on_period) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_type ORDER BY commissioned_on_period, id) + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM latest
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_type ORDER BY commissioned_on_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, fuel_type
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id, fuel_type
    FROM power_plants
    WHERE fuel_type = 'wind'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.fuel_type = k.fuel_type
),
summary AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        fuel_type,
        CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_new_session_tier,
        CASE WHEN downtime_minutes >= 415 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS downtime_minutes_tier,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(fuel_type)) AS fuel_type_list,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(fuel_type)) AS num_fuel_types,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fuel_type = 'hydro') AS hydro_rows
    FROM reconciled
    GROUP BY fuel_type, CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN downtime_minutes >= 415 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
)
SELECT
    fuel_type,
    is_new_session_tier,
    downtime_minutes_tier,
    fuel_type_list,
    num_fuel_types,
    hydro_rows
FROM summary
ORDER BY downtime_minutes_tier NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_power_plants
    .filter(F.month("commissioned_on").isin([5, 7, 11]))
    .withColumn("commissioned_on_period", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "commissioned_on"))
)

latest = (
    valid
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type").orderBy("commissioned_on", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_gaps = (
    latest
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("commissioned_on_period").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type").orderBy("commissioned_on_period", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("commissioned_on_period") > F.lag("commissioned_on_period").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type").orderBy("commissioned_on_period", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type").orderBy("commissioned_on_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

kept_keys = (
    islands
    .select("id", "fuel_type")
    .exceptAll(

        .filter(F.col("fuel_type") == "wind")

    .select("s.*")
)

    .agg(

        F.size(F.collect_set("fuel_type")).alias("num_fuel_types"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("fuel_type") == "hydro", 1)).alias("hydro_rows"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "fuel_type",
        "is_new_session_tier",
        "downtime_minutes_tier",
        "fuel_type_list",
        "num_fuel_types",
        "hydro_rows",
```
