```sql
        CASE WHEN donation_amt_int_bucket >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS donation_amt_int_bucket_tier,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(shelf_zone)) AS shelf_zone_list,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        COUNT_IF(shelf_zone = 'A') AS a_events
    FROM verified
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN donation_amt_int_bucket >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    HAVING a_events < 1000

    shelf_zone_list,

ORDER BY a_events;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_holds_queue
    .filter(F.col("patron_tier").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.col("donation_amt").cast("int").alias("donation_amt_int"))
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "shelf_zone",
        "patron_tier",
        "page_count",
        "joined_on",
        F.min("page_count").over(Window.partitionBy("catalog_item_ref").orderBy("donation_amt_int", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_page_count"),
        F.count("page_count").over(Window.partitionBy("catalog_item_ref").orderBy("donation_amt_int", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_page_count"),
        F.sum("page_count").over(Window.partitionBy("catalog_item_ref").orderBy("donation_amt_int", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_page_count"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("donation_amt_int").desc(), "id")).alias("donation_amt_int_bucket"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows
    .filter((F.col("joined_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-02-08"))) & (~F.col("patron_tier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("senior"))))
    .withColumn("donation_amt_int_bucket_times_page_count", (F.col("donation_amt_int_bucket") * F.col("page_count")))
    .withColumn("resolved_patron_tier", F.coalesce("patron_tier", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("patron_tier") == "child")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("running_min_page_count").over(Window.partitionBy("shelf_zone").orderBy("donation_amt_int_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_page_count_avg_6"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("patron_tier").orderBy(F.col("running_count_page_count").desc())).alias("running_count_page_count_percent_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("page_count").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "joined_on"), "patron_tier")).alias("joined_on_period_stddev_samp_page_count"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "joined_on"), "patron_tier").orderBy(F.col("page_count").desc(), "id")).alias("page_count_bucket"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("shelf_zone", "patron_tier").orderBy(F.col("page_count_bucket").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "shelf_zone",
        "page_count",
        "donation_amt_int_bucket",
        "resolved_patron_tier",
        "page_count_bucket",
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    latest
    .select("shelf_zone")
    .subtract(
        df_holds_queue
        .filter(F.col("page_count").between(618, 700))
        .select("shelf_zone")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.shelf_zone") == F.col("k.shelf_zone")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

daily = (
    verified
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("donation_amt_int_bucket") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("donation_amt_int_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("shelf_zone")).alias("shelf_zone_list"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("shelf_zone") == "A").alias("a_events"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("a_events") < 1000)
)

result = (
    daily
    .select("donation_amt_int_bucket_tier", "shelf_zone_list", "a_events")
    .orderBy("a_events")
)
```

```python
    .select(
        "id",
        "board_basis",
        "hotel_chain",
        "occupancy_pct",
        "task_minutes",
        "late_checkout",

        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("row_seq"),

        F.first("task_minutes", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("hotel_chain").orderBy("task_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_task_minutes"),
        F.avg("occupancy_pct").over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("occupancy_pct_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched_hotels
    .withColumn("seq_no_avg_6", F.avg("seq_no").over(Window.partitionBy("board_basis", "hotel_chain").orderBy("occupancy_pct", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("next_task_minutes_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("next_task_minutes").desc(), "id")))
```

```sql
    FROM latest
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM scored
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM settlement_payouts
    WHERE claim_state = 'DENIED'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,

        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_hist AS risk_score_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_part AS cumulative_risk_score_percent_rank
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE event_seq > 5
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY cumulative_risk_score DESC NULLS FIRST), w_hist AS (ORDER BY risk_score)
),
grouped AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS event_seq_tier,
        CASE WHEN cumulative_risk_score >= 408 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cumulative_risk_score_tier,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        AVG(cumulative_risk_score_dense_rank) AS avg_cumulative_risk_score_dense_rank,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(seq_no, 0.9) AS seq_no_p90,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(risk_score_bucket, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS risk_score_bucket_quartiles
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN cumulative_risk_score >= 408 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
)

    event_seq_tier,
    cumulative_risk_score_tier,
    num_rows,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.orderBy(F.col("cumulative_risk_score").desc_nulls_first())

cleaned = (
    df_settlement_payouts
    .filter((F.col("policy_start") > F.lit("2023-05-05").cast("date")) & F.col("loss_notice_no").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.year("policy_start").alias("policy_start_year"))
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("loss_notice_no", "adjuster_team").orderBy(F.col("policy_start_year").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "loss_notice_no",
        "adjuster_team",
        "claim_state",
        "risk_score",
        "policy_start",
    )
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "risk_score",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("risk_score").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.sum("risk_score").over(Window.orderBy("policy_start", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_risk_score"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("policy_start").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("policy_start"), "loss_notice_no").orderBy("risk_score", "id")).alias("risk_score_bucket"),
        F.avg("risk_score").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_team", "loss_notice_no").orderBy("risk_score", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("risk_score_avg_6"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_settlement_payouts
        .filter(F.col("claim_state") == "DENIED")
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("event_seq") > 5)
    .withColumn("event_seq_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy("event_seq")))
    .withColumn("cumulative_risk_score_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_part))
    .withColumn("risk_score_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("cumulative_risk_score_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_part))

        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("event_seq_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_risk_score") >= 408, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("cumulative_risk_score_tier"),

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.avg("cumulative_risk_score_dense_rank").alias("avg_cumulative_risk_score_dense_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", 0.9).alias("seq_no_p90"),
        F.percentile_approx("risk_score_bucket", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("risk_score_bucket_quartiles"),
    )
)

        "cumulative_risk_score_tier",
        "num_rows",
        "avg_cumulative_risk_score_dense_rank",
        "seq_no_p90",
        "risk_score_bucket_quartiles",
```

```sql
    FROM base

),
```

```sql
),
metrics_factories AS (

        *,
        ROUND(running_sum_torque_nm / SUM(running_sum_torque_nm) OVER (PARTITION BY defect_kind), 4) AS running_sum_torque_nm_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY running_count_torque_nm DESC) AS running_count_torque_nm_dense_rank
    FROM verified
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_count_torque_nm_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS running_count_torque_nm_dense_rank_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', production_line_started_on) AS year_start,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT_IF(defect_kind = 'scratch') AS scratch_events,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE defect_kind = 'scratch') AS scratch_rows
FROM metrics_factories
GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_count_torque_nm_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', production_line_started_on)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_factories
    .filter(F.col("defect_kind").isNotNull() & (F.col("started_on") > F.lit("2023-05-21").cast("date")))
    .withColumn("torque_nm_level", F.when(F.col("torque_nm") >= 312, "High").when(F.col("torque_nm") >= 84, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("defect_kind_clean", F.coalesce("defect_kind", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("torque_nm") < 100)
    .select(
        "id",
        "defect_kind",
        "started_on",
        "machine_tag",
        "is_rework",
        "defect_kind_clean",
        F.sum("torque_nm").over(Window.partitionBy("shift_cd").orderBy("torque_nm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_torque_nm"),
        F.count("torque_nm").over(Window.partitionBy("shift_cd").orderBy("torque_nm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_torque_nm"),
        F.avg("torque_nm").over(Window.partitionBy("shift_cd").orderBy("torque_nm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_torque_nm"),
    )

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_production_lines.alias("c"), (F.col("c.factory_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.started_on") <= F.col("s.started_on")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.started_on").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.started_on").alias("production_line_started_on"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_last
    .select("id", "defect_kind")
    .intersectAll(
        df_factories
        .filter(F.col("torque_nm") <= 290)
        .select("id", "defect_kind")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.defect_kind") == F.col("k.defect_kind")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

    )
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

metrics = (
    df_loan_apps
    .filter(~F.col("applicant_ref").like("%998%"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "bank_branche_id",
        "teller_grade",
        "credit_band",
        "decided_on",
        "applicant_ref",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "decided_on")).orderBy(F.col("atm_cash_level").desc_nulls_last())).alias("atm_cash_level_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("credit_band") / F.sum("credit_band").over(Window.partitionBy("teller_grade"))), 4).alias("credit_band_share"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("credit_band").desc(), "id")).alias("credit_band_bucket"),
        F.avg("credit_band").over(Window.partitionBy("bank_branche_id").orderBy("decided_on", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("credit_band_avg_3_prior"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("bank_branche_id").orderBy(F.col("credit_band").asc_nulls_first())).alias("credit_band_rank"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("bank_branche_id").orderBy(F.col("credit_band_share").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.bank_branche_id",
        "a.credit_band",
        "a.decided_on",
        "a.atm_cash_level_dense_rank",
        "a.credit_band_share",
        "a.credit_band_rank",
        F.col("b.txn_cnt"),
        F.col("b.loan_purpose"),
        F.col("b.drawer_balance"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("loan_purpose").orderBy(F.col("credit_band").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
```

```python
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("broadcast_id", "spot_kind").orderBy("panel_size_per_share_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_ad_spots
    .filter((F.col("aired_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-29"))) & (F.upper(F.trim("program_title")) == "GOAL RUSH"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "broadcast_id",
        "spot_kind",
        "share_pct",
        "aired_on",
        "program_title",
        "is_rerun",
        (F.col("panel_size") / F.nullif("share_pct", F.lit(0))).alias("panel_size_per_share_pct"),
        F.last_day("aired_on").alias("aired_on_month_end"),
        F.coalesce("spot_kind", F.lit("NONE")).alias("spot_kind_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_broadcasts.alias("d"), F.col("src.broadcast_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.size(F.col("d.audience_tags")) > 1)
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.broadcast_id",
        "src.spot_kind",
        "src.share_pct",
        "src.program_title",
        "src.is_rerun",
        "src.panel_size_per_share_pct",
        F.col("d.rating_pts"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("broadcast_id").orderBy(F.col("rating_pts").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

enriched_ad_spots = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "broadcast_id",
        "panel_size_per_share_pct",
        "rating_pts",
        F.count("rating_pts").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_rating_pts"),
        F.min("rating_pts").over(w_ordered).alias("running_min_rating_pts"),
        F.max("rating_pts").over(w_ordered).alias("running_max_rating_pts"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("broadcast_id").orderBy("panel_size_per_share_pct", "id")).alias("panel_size_per_share_pct_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_ad_spots
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_broadcasts.alias("b"), F.col("s.broadcast_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .rollup(
        F.col("b.spot_type").alias("spot_type"),
        F.col("b.daypart").alias("daypart"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.max(F.col("s.panel_size_per_share_pct_bucket")).alias("max_panel_size_per_share_pct_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("max_panel_size_per_share_pct_bucket").desc())
)
```

```python
w_part = Window.partitionBy("terminal_code").orderBy("running_bag_weight_kg", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_gates.alias("g"), F.col("src.gate_id") == F.col("g.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("g.bag_state"))
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "opened_on"), "terminal_code").orderBy("gate_capacity")).alias("gate_capacity_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("bag_weight_kg").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("opened_on")).orderBy("opened_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_bag_weight_kg"),
```

```sql
        CORR(ticket_price, merch_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(announced_on), show_status) AS corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue
    FROM setlists
    WHERE merch_revenue < 61000
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach concerts attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        p.ticket_px,
        p.act_name
    FROM metrics src
    LEFT JOIN concerts p
        ON src.concert_no = p.id
),
with_dims_setlists AS (
    -- Attach concerts attributes
    SELECT s.*, c.announced_date
    FROM with_dims s
    LEFT JOIN concerts c
        ON s.concert_no = c.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach concerts attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.stage_width_m,
        p.announced_date AS concert_announced_date,
        p.act_name AS concert_act_name
    FROM with_dims_setlists e
    LEFT JOIN concerts p
        ON e.concert_no = p.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY concert_no ORDER BY ticket_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue_avg_6_prior,
        CORR(merch_revenue, seats_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY concert_no) AS corr_merch_revenue_seats_sold
    FROM enriched
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    concert_no,
    CASE WHEN stage_width_m >= 36.6 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS stage_width_m_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue_avg_6_prior, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue_avg_6_prior_quartiles,
    COUNT_IF(show_status = 'sold_out') AS sold_out_events,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(cumulative_merch_revenue, 0.95) AS cumulative_merch_revenue_p95,
    AVG(ticket_price) FILTER (WHERE show_status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_avg_ticket_price,
    MAX(seats_sold) AS max_seats_sold
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY concert_no, CASE WHEN stage_width_m >= 36.6 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY cancelled_avg_ticket_price NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

metrics = (
    df_setlists
    .filter(F.col("merch_revenue") < 61000)
    .withColumn("cumulative_merch_revenue", F.sum("merch_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("sale_channel", "show_status").orderBy("ticket_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("first_known_sale_channel", F.first("sale_channel", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "announced_on"), "show_status").orderBy("seats_sold", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_ticket_price", F.sum("ticket_price").over(Window.partitionBy("show_status").orderBy("seats_sold", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("next_seats_sold", F.lead("seats_sold", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("sale_channel").orderBy("merch_revenue", "id")))
    .withColumn("corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue", F.corr("ticket_price", "merch_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("announced_on"), "show_status")))
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_concerts.alias("p"), F.col("src.concert_no") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.ticket_px"), F.col("p.act_name"))
)

with_dims_setlists = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_concerts.alias("c"), F.col("s.concert_no") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.announced_date"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims_setlists
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_concerts.alias("p"), F.col("e.concert_no") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("p.stage_width_m"),
        F.col("p.announced_date").alias("concert_announced_date"),
        F.col("p.act_name").alias("concert_act_name"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue_avg_6_prior", F.avg("corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("concert_no").orderBy("ticket_price", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)))
    .withColumn("corr_merch_revenue_seats_sold", F.corr("merch_revenue", "seats_sold").over(Window.partitionBy("concert_no")))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        "concert_no",
        F.when(F.col("stage_width_m") >= 36.6, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("stage_width_m_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue_avg_6_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("corr_ticket_price_merch_revenue_avg_6_prior_quartiles"),
        F.count_if(F.col("show_status") == "sold_out").alias("sold_out_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("cumulative_merch_revenue", 0.95).alias("cumulative_merch_revenue_p95"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("show_status") == "cancelled", F.col("ticket_price"))).alias("cancelled_avg_ticket_price"),
        F.max("seats_sold").alias("max_seats_sold"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("cancelled_avg_ticket_price").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
    from gaps
),
with_windows as (

    select

        cume_dist() over (partition by district_code order by bedroom_cnt nulls first) bedroom_cnt_cume_dist,

),

),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_offer_made_at is null or offer_made_at > prev_offer_made_at + interval '7' day then 1 else 0 end as new_group_flag
    from prev_events
),
sessionized_viewings as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(new_group_flag) over (partition by district_code order by offer_made_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from flagged
)
select
    id,
    district_code,
    street_line,

    bedroom_cnt_cume_dist,
    bedroom_cnt_rounded_cume_dist,
    prev_offer_made_at,
    new_group_flag,
    case when district_code rlike '^(D04|D03)$' then 'EXTENDED' when district_code rlike '^(D01|D02)$' then 'OTHER_ZONE' else 'GROUP_A' end as district_code_zone

order by district_code_zone desc nulls last, district_code;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_viewings
    .filter(F.col("district_code").isNotNull() & (~F.col("district_code").eqNullSafe(F.lit("D05"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "district_code",
        "bedroom_cnt",
        "asking_price",
        "offer_made_at",
        "street_line",
        "amenity_codes",
        F.round("bedroom_cnt", 0).alias("bedroom_cnt_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("district_code", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("district_code_filled"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    valid
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("offer_made_at") - F.lag("offer_made_at").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code").orderBy("offer_made_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "district_code",
        "bedroom_cnt",
        "offer_made_at",
        "street_line",
        "amenity_codes",
        "bedroom_cnt_rounded",
        "district_code_filled",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code").orderBy("offer_made_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),

)

)

prev_events = with_windows.withColumn("prev_offer_made_at", F.lag("offer_made_at").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code").orderBy("offer_made_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_offer_made_at").isNull() | (F.col("offer_made_at") > F.col("prev_offer_made_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized_viewings = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code").orderBy("offer_made_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessionized_viewings
    .select(
        "id",
        "district_code",
        "street_line",
        "district_code_filled",
        "session_no",
```

```sql
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(material_type)) AS material_type_list,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(incident_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(incident_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    MAX(prev_incident_ts) AS ended_at,
    ROUND(SUM(floor_count) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN material_type = 'timber' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS floor_count_per_timber
FROM islands
```

```sql
        id,
        listing_no,
        listing_status,
        storey_no,
        street_line,
        monthly_rent_int,
        SUM(monthly_rent) OVER (PARTITION BY offer_state ORDER BY CAST(offer_made_at_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS monthly_rent_sum_90d,
        ROUND(offer_amt / SUM(offer_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', offer_made_at_period), listing_status), 4) AS offer_amt_share
    FROM valid
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY listing_status ORDER BY offer_amt_share NULLS LAST) AS offer_amt_share_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_grp AS offer_amt_share_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY listing_no, listing_status ORDER BY offer_amt_share DESC) AS offer_amt_share_cume_dist
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY offer_amt_share DESC)
)
SELECT
    id,
    listing_no,
    listing_status,
    monthly_rent_int,
    monthly_rent_sum_90d,
    offer_amt_share,
    offer_amt_share_dense_rank,
    offer_amt_share_rank
FROM scored;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("offer_amt_share").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_fact_valuations
    .filter(F.col("offer_made_at") >= F.lit("2023-09-13").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("listing_status_street_line", F.concat("listing_status", F.lit(" "), "street_line"))
    .withColumn("monthly_rent_int", F.col("monthly_rent").cast("int"))
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("listing_no")
    .subtract(
        df_fact_valuations
        .filter(~F.col("offer_state").isin(["rejected", "pending"]))
        .select("listing_no")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.listing_no") == F.col("k.listing_no")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("offer_state").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("offer_made_at_period", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "offer_made_at"))
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "listing_no",
        "listing_status",
        "storey_no",
        "street_line",
        "monthly_rent_int",
        F.sum("monthly_rent").over(Window.partitionBy("offer_state").orderBy(F.col("offer_made_at_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)).alias("monthly_rent_sum_90d"),
        F.round((F.col("offer_amt") / F.sum("offer_amt").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "offer_made_at_period"), "listing_status"))), 4).alias("offer_amt_share"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("listing_status").orderBy(F.col("offer_amt_share").asc_nulls_last())).alias("offer_amt_share_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_grp).alias("offer_amt_share_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("listing_no", "listing_status").orderBy(F.col("offer_amt_share").desc())).alias("offer_amt_share_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "listing_no",
        "listing_status",
        "monthly_rent_int",
        "monthly_rent_sum_90d",
        "offer_amt_share",
        "offer_amt_share_dense_rank",
        "offer_amt_share_rank",

)
```

```sql
            FROM part_swaps c

-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', delivered_on) AS year_start,
    CASE WHEN egt_margin_c >= 50 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS egt_margin_c_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(egt_margin_c) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN airframe = 'A350' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS egt_margin_c_per_a350,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN airframe = 'B737' THEN 1 END) AS b737_count,
    ROUND(AVG(egt_margin_c), 2) AS avg_egt_margin_c
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', delivered_on), CASE WHEN egt_margin_c >= 50 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
HAVING ROUND(SUM(egt_margin_c) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN airframe = 'A350' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) > 0
```

```python
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.cycle_count").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
```

```sql
    SELECT
        *,
        IF(is_rerun, 'Yes', 'No') AS is_rerun_label,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', aired_on) AS aired_on_period,
        COALESCE(panel_region, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_panel_region
    FROM rating_samples
    WHERE aired_on >= TO_DATE('2023-05-08')
      AND panel_region IS NOT NULL
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(aired_on_period) OVER (PARTITION BY panel_region ORDER BY aired_on_period, id) IS NULL
                 OR aired_on_period > LAG(aired_on_period) OVER (PARTITION BY panel_region ORDER BY aired_on_period, id) + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM valid
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        panel_region,
        spot_rate,
        aired_on,
        program_title,
        is_rerun_label,
        aired_on_period,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY panel_region ORDER BY aired_on_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM islands
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY panel_region ORDER BY aired_on_period NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
deduped_rating_samples AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)

        id,
        spot_rate,
        aired_on,
        program_title,
        is_rerun_label,
        session_id

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY panel_region ORDER BY aired_on_period, id) = 1
),
metrics AS (

        aired_on,
        session_id,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY aired_on DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        LAG(session_id, 1) OVER (ORDER BY aired_on, id) AS prev_session_id
    FROM deduped_rating_samples
),
base AS (

        ROUND(spot_rate * 1.1, 2) AS spot_rate_adjusted
    FROM metrics
    WHERE aired_on >= DATE '2023-04-27'
```

```sql
    FROM enriched
    WHERE class_slot_gym_area IS NOT NULL
      AND heart_rate_mean >= 153
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        GREATEST(class_slot_slot_capacity, heart_rate_mean) greatest_class_slot_slot_capacity_heart_rate_mean,
        COALESCE(gym_area, 'N/A') resolved_gym_area
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE class_slot_gym_area != 'studio'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER

        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gym_area, class_slot_gym_area ORDER BY class_slot_slot_capacity DESC) AS latest_rank
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        heart_rate_mean + greatest_class_slot_slot_capacity_heart_rate_mean heart_rate_mean_plus_greatest_class_slot_slot_capacity_heart_rate_mean,
        LOWER(gym_area) gym_area_lower,
        COALESCE(gym_area, 'DIRECT') gym_area_filled
    FROM ranked
    WHERE gym_area IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    id,
    gym_area,
    heart_rate_mean,
    class_slot_gym_area,
    class_slot_slot_capacity,
    coach_name_upper,
    greatest_class_slot_slot_capacity_heart_rate_mean,
    row_num,
    latest_rank,
    CASE WHEN gym_area RLIKE '^(cardio|free_weights)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS gym_area_zone
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        channels_tv_id,
        daypart,
        spot_type,
        rating_pts,
        share_percent,
        spot_rt,
        spot_aired_ts,

enriched AS (

    FROM base s

        ON s.channels_tv_id <=> c.id
),
enriched_broadcasts AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(share_percent) OVER (PARTITION BY daypart ORDER BY share_percent ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_share_percent,
        CORR(spot_rt, share_percent) OVER w_recent AS corr_spot_rt_share_percent,
        COUNT(rating_pts) OVER w_running AS daypart_count_rating_pts
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(spot_aired_ts)), w_running AS (PARTITION BY daypart, channels_tv_id)
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN spot_aired_ts - LAG(spot_aired_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY daypart ORDER BY spot_aired_ts ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM enriched_broadcasts
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        channels_tv_id,
        daypart,
        rating_pts,
        share_percent,
        spot_aired_ts,
        program_title,
        is_morning,
        share_pct,
        cumulative_share_percent,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY daypart ORDER BY spot_aired_ts ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT daypart, id
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT
    SELECT daypart, id
    FROM broadcasts
    WHERE channels_tv_id = 31
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.daypart = k.daypart AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    channels_tv_id,
    MIN(spot_aired_ts) AS first_seen,
    MAX(cumulative_share_percent) AS max_cumulative_share_percent,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE daypart = 'morning') AS morning_rows,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(is_morning, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS is_morning_quartiles,
    SUM(CASE WHEN daypart = 'daytime' THEN share_pct ELSE 0 END) AS daytime_share_pct
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY channels_tv_id
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE daypart = 'morning') >= 1;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("spot_aired_ts"))
w_running = Window.partitionBy("daypart", "channels_tv_id")

base = (
    df_broadcasts
    .filter(F.col("spot_type").isNotNull() & (F.to_date("spot_aired_ts") >= "2025-02-25"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channels_tv_id",
        "daypart",
        "spot_type",
        "rating_pts",
        "share_percent",
        "spot_rt",
        "spot_aired_ts",
        "program_title",
        F.when(F.col("daypart") == "morning", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_morning"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_channels_tv.alias("c"), F.col("s.channels_tv_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.rating_pts").alias("channels_tv_rating_pts"),
        F.col("c.share_pct"),
    )
)

enriched_broadcasts = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("share_percent").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("share_percent", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_share_percent"),
        F.corr("spot_rt", "share_percent").over(w_recent).alias("corr_spot_rt_share_percent"),
        F.count("rating_pts").over(w_running).alias("daypart_count_rating_pts"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    enriched_broadcasts
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("spot_aired_ts") - F.lag("spot_aired_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "channels_tv_id",
        "daypart",
        "rating_pts",
        "share_percent",
        "spot_aired_ts",
        "program_title",
        "is_morning",
        "share_pct",
        "cumulative_share_percent",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    islands
    .select("daypart", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_broadcasts
        .filter(F.col("channels_tv_id") == 31)
        .select("daypart", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    islands
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.daypart") == F.col("k.daypart")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy("channels_tv_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("spot_aired_ts").alias("first_seen"),
        F.max("cumulative_share_percent").alias("max_cumulative_share_percent"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("daypart") == "morning", 1)).alias("morning_rows"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("defect_kind").orderBy("units_built", "id")

metrics = (
    df_dim_shifts
    .filter(F.array_contains("tool_codes", "GR"))
    .withColumn("next_defect_cnt", F.lead("defect_cnt").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("prev_units_built", F.lag("units_built").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_units_built", F.lead("units_built").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
)

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("started_on") >= F.lit("2023-03-08").cast("date")) & F.col("order_priority").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.add_months("started_on", 12).alias("started_on_plus_months"),
        F.coalesce("order_priority", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_order_priority"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_priority").orderBy(F.col("next_defect_cnt").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))

)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy("order_priority")
    .agg(
        F.max("next_units_built").alias("max_next_units_built"),
```

```sql
    FROM dim_grid_zones

    FROM gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', outage_started_at) AS week_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN zone_code = 'Z1' THEN session_id ELSE 0 END) AS z1_session_id,
    SUM(session_start_flag) AS total_session_start_flag,
    ROUND(SUM(voltage_kv) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN zone_code = 'Z4' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS voltage_kv_per_z4
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.charged_at").alias("room_type_charged_at"))
)

deduped = (
    with_last
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("hotel_chain").orderBy(F.col("task_minutes").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)

)

sessionized = (

    .select(

        "hotel_chain",
        "task_minutes",
        "late_checkout",
        "perk_codes",
        "greatest_occupancy_pct_task_minutes",
        "room_type_charged_at",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("hotel_chain").orderBy("room_type_charged_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

latest = (
```

```python
        F.lead("membership_fee", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("gym_area").orderBy("slot_capacity", "id")).alias("next_membership_fee"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("season_tag").orderBy(F.col("germination_pct").desc(), "id")

w_part = Window.partitionBy("season_tag").orderBy(F.col("is_organic_flag_avg_2_prior").desc_nulls_first())

base = (
    df_harvest_logs
    .filter(F.col("soil_class").isNotNull())

        "season_tag",

        "valve_opened_at",
        "plot_nickname",
        "is_organic",
        F.col("is_organic").cast("int").alias("is_organic_flag"),

)

with_windows = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("valve_opened_at") >= "2024-12-01")
    .withColumn("germination_pct_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("cumulative_germination_pct", F.sum("germination_pct").over(w_ordered))
```

```sql
    WHERE has_parking
      AND offer_made_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-24 10:00:00'
),
remaining_keys_2 AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM rent_ledgers
    WHERE has_parking = FALSE
),
kept_rows_rent_ledgers AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN remaining_keys_2 k ON s.id = k.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN offer_amt_scaled >= 73 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS offer_amt_scaled_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT listing_ref) AS distinct_listing_refs,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    ROUND(AVG(offer_amt_scaled), 2) AS avg_offer_amt_scaled
FROM kept_rows_rent_ledgers
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_rent_ledgers
    .filter((F.col("offer_made_at") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-19"))) & F.col("listing_ref").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "listing_ref",
        "bedroom_cnt",
        "offer_amt",
        "offer_made_at",
        "street_line",
        "has_parking",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "offer_made_at").alias("days_since_offer_made_at"),
        F.when(F.col("bedroom_cnt") >= 4, "High").when(F.col("bedroom_cnt") >= 2, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("bedroom_cnt_tier"),
        F.coalesce("offer_state", F.lit("NONE")).alias("offer_state_filled"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    base
    .select("listing_ref")
    .intersect(
        df_rent_ledgers
        .filter(F.col("bedroom_cnt") >= 5)
        .select("listing_ref")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.listing_ref") == F.col("k.listing_ref")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("has_parking") & (F.col("offer_made_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-24 10:00:00").cast("timestamp")))

    filtered
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_rent_ledgers
        .filter(~F.col("has_parking"))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows_rent_ledgers = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows_rent_ledgers
    .rollup(

    .agg(
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.orderBy("cycle_seconds", "id")

    df_defect_reports
    .filter((F.col("started_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-29"))) & F.col("work_order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "work_order_id",
        "order_priority",
        "cycle_seconds",
        F.substring("order_priority", 1, 4).alias("order_priority_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("line_type", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("line_type_clean"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("first_known_cycle_seconds", F.first("cycle_seconds", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("work_order_id").orderBy("cycle_seconds", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("prev_cycle_seconds", F.lag("cycle_seconds", 1, 0).over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("cycle_seconds").desc(), "id")))
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "work_order_id",
        "order_priority",
        "cycle_seconds",
        F.sum("cycle_seconds").over(Window.partitionBy("work_order_id").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_sum_cycle_seconds"),

    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_priority", "work_order_id").orderBy(F.col("last7_sum_cycle_seconds").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

result = (
    latest
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_work_orders.alias("w"), F.col("e.work_order_id") == F.col("w.id"), "inner")
    .cube(
        F.col("w.shift_code").alias("shift_code"),
        F.col("e.order_priority").alias("order_priority"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.max(F.col("e.last7_max_cycle_seconds")).alias("max_last7_max_cycle_seconds"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("e.cycle_seconds")), 2).alias("avg_cycle_seconds"),
```

```sql
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seats_sold_minus_stage_width_m DESC, id ASC) AS row_seq_2
    FROM base
    WHERE genre_code = 'edm'
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching concert per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.ticket_px
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.ticket_px
            FROM concerts c
            WHERE c.venues_ev_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stage_width_m DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
valid AS (

)

    stage_width_m,
    act_name,
    clean_act_name,
    seq_no,
    row_seq,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

metrics = (

    .filter(F.col("genre_code") == "edm")
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("genre_code").orderBy(F.col("seats_sold_minus_stage_width_m").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("tier_section").orderBy("seats_sold_minus_stage_width_m", "id")))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scored = (
    df_cpu_samples

        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("cloud_region", "page_sev").orderBy("mem_gib")).alias("mem_gib_rank"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("vcpu_cnt_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("vm_instance_id").orderBy(F.col("vcpu_cnt").desc_nulls_first())))
    .withColumn("cost_per_hr_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy("cost_per_hr", "id")))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("provisioned_on"), "cloud_region").orderBy("cost_per_hr", "id")))
    .withColumn("first_known_vcpu_cnt", F.first("vcpu_cnt", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "provisioned_on"), "page_sev").orderBy("cost_per_hr", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)
```

```sql
totals AS (
```

```sql
            ORDER BY c.pulse_bpm DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1

),

    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM vital_logs ch
            WHERE ch.care_plan_id = s.id
              AND ch.filled_on >= s.plan_start_day
        )
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT fill_state, id
    FROM kept
    EXCEPT
    SELECT fill_state, id
    FROM care_plans
    WHERE clinics_v_no IN (16, 17, 23, 26)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.fill_state = k.fill_state AND s.id = k.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(systolic_mm) OVER (PARTITION BY fill_state, pharmacy_fill_ward_code) AS fill_state_avg_systolic_mm,
        ROUND(pulse_bpm / SUM(pulse_bpm) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(plan_start_day), fill_state), 4) AS pulse_bpm_share,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pulse_bpm DESC) AS pulse_bpm_percent_rank,
        MIN(pulse_bpm) OVER (PARTITION BY pharmacy_fill_ward_code) AS pharmacy_fill_ward_code_min_pulse_bpm,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY pulse_bpm DESC NULLS LAST) AS pulse_bpm_cume_dist

),
eligible AS (

            WHERE c.care_plan_id = s.id
              AND c.filled_on < s.plan_start_day

),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        fill_state,
        systolic_mm,
        plan_start_day,
        fill_state_avg_systolic_mm,
        pulse_bpm_share,
        pulse_bpm_percent_rank,
        pharmacy_fill_ward_code_min_pulse_bpm,
        pulse_bpm_cume_dist,
        ROUND(pulse_bpm / SUM(pulse_bpm) OVER (PARTITION BY pharmacy_fill_ward_code), 4) AS pulse_bpm_share_2,
        SUM(systolic_mm) OVER (PARTITION BY ward_code) AS ward_code_sum_systolic_mm,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(plan_start_day) ORDER BY pulse_bpm) AS pulse_bpm_percent_rank_2

    SUM(pulse_bpm_share_2) FILTER (WHERE fill_state = 'partial') AS partial_total_pulse_bpm_share_2,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_latest = (
    df_care_plans
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_pharmacy_fills.alias("c"), (F.col("c.care_plan_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.pulse_bpm").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.ward_code",
        "s.fill_state",
        "s.systolic_mm",
        "s.plan_start_day",
        "s.needs_followup",
        F.col("c.pulse_bpm"),
        F.col("c.ward_code").alias("pharmacy_fill_ward_code"),
    )
)

kept = (
    with_latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_vital_logs.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.care_plan_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.filled_on") >= F.col("s.plan_start_day")), "left_anti")
)

remaining_keys = (
    kept
    .select("fill_state", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_care_plans
        .filter(F.col("clinics_v_no").isin([16, 17, 23, 26]))
        .select("fill_state", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.fill_state") == F.col("k.fill_state")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("pharmacy_fill_ward_code") != "W1")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("systolic_mm").over(Window.partitionBy("fill_state", "pharmacy_fill_ward_code")).alias("fill_state_avg_systolic_mm"),
        F.round((F.col("pulse_bpm") / F.sum("pulse_bpm").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("plan_start_day"), "fill_state"))), 4).alias("pulse_bpm_share"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("pulse_bpm").desc())).alias("pulse_bpm_percent_rank"),
        F.min("pulse_bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("pharmacy_fill_ward_code")).alias("pharmacy_fill_ward_code_min_pulse_bpm"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("pulse_bpm").desc_nulls_last())).alias("pulse_bpm_cume_dist"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_vital_logs.alias("c"), (F.col("c.care_plan_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.filled_on") < F.col("s.plan_start_day")), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "id",
        "fill_state",
        "systolic_mm",
        "plan_start_day",
        "fill_state_avg_systolic_mm",
        "pulse_bpm_share",
        "pulse_bpm_percent_rank",
        "pharmacy_fill_ward_code_min_pulse_bpm",
        "pulse_bpm_cume_dist",
        F.round((F.col("pulse_bpm") / F.sum("pulse_bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("pharmacy_fill_ward_code"))), 4).alias("pulse_bpm_share_2"),
        F.sum("systolic_mm").over(Window.partitionBy("ward_code")).alias("ward_code_sum_systolic_mm"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("plan_start_day")).orderBy("pulse_bpm")).alias("pulse_bpm_percent_rank_2"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id", "fill_state")
    .intersect(
        df_care_plans
        .filter(F.col("needs_followup"))
        .select("id", "fill_state")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.fill_state") == F.col("k.fill_state")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy(
        "fill_state",
        F.when(F.col("systolic_mm") >= 178, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("systolic_mm_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("fill_state")).alias("fill_state_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("fill_state_avg_systolic_mm", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("fill_state_avg_systolic_mm_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("fill_state") == "partial", F.col("pulse_bpm_share_2"))).alias("partial_total_pulse_bpm_share_2"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("fill_state")).alias("fill_state_list_2"),
        F.countDistinct("fill_state").alias("distinct_fill_states"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_fill_states").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
reconciled AS (

metrics AS (

)
```

```python
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("depot_zone").orderBy(F.col("tapped_ts").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
```

```sql
            WHERE c.storefront_id = s.id

        ) latest ON TRUE

    SELECT s.*, top1.basket_state
    FROM with_last s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.basket_state
            FROM fact_reviews c
            WHERE c.storefront_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.basket_total DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_last_storefronts AS (
    -- Latest matching fact_review per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.fact_review_store_tier
    FROM with_latest s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.store_tier AS fact_review_store_tier
            FROM fact_reviews c
            WHERE c.storefront_id = s.id
              AND c.account_opened_on <= s.fact_review_account_opened_on
            ORDER BY c.account_opened_on DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
-- Multi-level aggregation

    CASE WHEN voucher_amt >= 43 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS voucher_amt_tier,

    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(voucher_amt), 2) AS avg_voucher_amt
FROM with_last_storefronts
GROUP BY CASE WHEN voucher_amt >= 43 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
```

```python
    df_storefronts

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_fact_reviews.alias("c"), (F.col("c.storefront_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.basket_total").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(

        "s.store_tier",
        "s.voucher_amt",
        "s.account_opened_on",
        "s.shopper_handle",
        "s.store_tier_lower",

)
```

```sql
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY teller_grade ORDER BY next_drawer_balance DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num

    COUNT_IF(app_state = 'submitted') AS submitted_events,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(is_t2), 2) AS avg_is_t2
FROM deduped
GROUP BY CASE WHEN row_seq >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN prev_is_t2_2 >= 85 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, app_state;
```

```python
    df_cash_drawers

        "teller_grade",
        "app_state",
        "drawer_balance",
        "loan_amt_req",
        "decided_on",
        F.when(F.col("teller_grade") == "T2", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_t2"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("decided_on") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-23"))) & F.col("app_state").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("teller_grade") == "T2", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_t2_2"),
        F.coalesce("app_state", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_app_state"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("prev_drawer_balance", F.lag("drawer_balance").over(Window.partitionBy("teller_grade").orderBy("is_t2", "id")))
    .withColumn("next_drawer_balance", F.lead("drawer_balance").over(Window.partitionBy("teller_grade").orderBy("is_t2", "id")))
```

```sql
        FROM gyms
    ) ranked

        signup_state,
        session_started_at,
        flag_has_locker,
        dedup_rank
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY signup_state ORDER BY session_mins, id) = 1

ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (

        FROM deduped_gyms
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1

gaps AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN session_started_at - LAG(session_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY class_type ORDER BY session_started_at, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM ranked

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        class_type,
        signup_state,
        session_started_at,

    FROM gaps

    FROM sessionized

    FROM flagged
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_start_flag_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_started_at) AS activity_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_state = 'booked' THEN session_start_flag ELSE 0 END) AS booked_session_start_flag,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_state = 'no_show') AS no_show_rows,
    MAX(island_id) FILTER (WHERE signup_state = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_max_island_id,
    ROUND(SUM(session_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN signup_state = 'attended' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS session_id_per_attended,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_state = 'no_show' THEN session_start_flag ELSE 0 END) AS no_show_session_start_flag
FROM islands
GROUP BY CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_started_at)
ORDER BY session_id_per_attended NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

deduped = (
    df_gyms
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("signup_state", "class_type").orderBy(F.col("session_started_at").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

deduped_gyms = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("dedup_rank_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("signup_state").orderBy("session_mins", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank_2") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "class_type",
        "signup_state",
        "session_started_at",
        "flag_has_locker",
        "dedup_rank",
    )
)

ranked = (
    deduped_gyms
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("class_type").orderBy(F.col("session_started_at").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

gaps = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("session_started_at") - F.lag("session_started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("class_type").orderBy("session_started_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "class_type",
        "signup_state",
        "session_started_at",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("class_type").orderBy("session_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("session_started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("class_type").orderBy("session_started_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("session_started_at") > F.lag("session_started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("class_type").orderBy("session_started_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("class_type").orderBy("session_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("session_start_flag") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("session_start_flag_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "session_started_at").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("signup_state") == "booked", F.col("session_start_flag")).otherwise(0)).alias("booked_session_start_flag"),
```

```sql
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', spot_aired_ts) AS year_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    SUM(share_percent) FILTER (WHERE spot_type = 'promo') AS promo_total_share_percent,
    STDDEV_SAMP(share_percent) AS share_percent_stddev,
    MIN(spot_aired_ts) AS first_spot_aired_ts,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN burst_id >= 6 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END) AS gid
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN burst_id >= 6 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', spot_aired_ts)), (CASE WHEN burst_id >= 6 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END))
```

```sql
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(next_vcpu_cnt, 0.95) AS next_vcpu_cnt_p95
```
